Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: PSX GLIMPSE product is designed to support the same system event messages as the PSX TotalView-ITCH feed. On PSX GLIMPSE, PSX will send out system event messages for those events that occurred up to the time of the PSX GLIMPSE snapshot request.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Always 0

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See System Event Codes below.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: Add Order - No MPID Attribution Message. This message will be generated for unattributed orders accepted by the PSX system.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Message.Name: Add Order MPID Attribution Message
Message.Description: Add Order with MPID Attribution Message. This message will be generated for attributed orders and quotations accepted by the PSX system. Note: This message will not be supported for NASDAQ OMX PSX for initial market launch.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Attribution
Field.Description: PSX market participant identifier associated with the entered order.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, NASDAQ OMX PSX disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in the system for the current trading day. Please note that the Symbol Directory spin may include halted issues. Firms must process the Trading Action message for current trading state information.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the directory message was generated. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in PSX.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For NASDAQ-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if NASDAQ or PSX system limits order entry for issue

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ. See Appendix for allowable values.

Field.Name: Issue Sub-Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ. See Appendix for allowable values.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in NASDAQ systems in a live/production, test, or demo state. Please note that firms should only show live issues and quoting participants on public quotation displays.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the NASDAQ security is set up for IPO release. This field is intended to help NASDAQ market participant firms comply with FINRA Rule 5131(b).

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument. Refer to LULD Rule for details.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product (ETP)

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index. Example: If the underlying Index increases by a value of 1 and the ETP's Leverage factor is 3, indicates the ETF will increase/decrease (see Inverse) by 3. Note: Leverage Factor of 1 indicates the ETP is NOT leveraged. This field is used for LULD Tier I price band calculation purposes.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and Underlying index.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: In the GLIMPSE transmission, PSX will send out a Stock Trading Action message for only those NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSE Amex, NYSE Arca and BATS issues that were eligible for trading during the current trading session.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Indicates the trading state for the issue at the time of the GLIMPSE transmission.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Trading Action reason.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Restriction Message
Message.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: End of Snapshot Message
Message.Description: The Snapshot message reflects the PSX TotalView-ITCH 5.0 sequence number at the time that the PSX GLIMPSE 5.0 spin was requested.

Field.Name: Itch Sequence Number
Field.Description: PSX TotalView-ITCH 5.0 sequence number when the PSX GLIMPSE 5.0 snapshot was taken. Note: While PSX TotalView-ITCH 5.0 is a binary data feed, the SoupBINTCP protocol uses ASCII characters for the sequence number in the logon request message format.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that PSX is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System hours
Value.Description: It indicates that PSX is now closed and will not accept any new orders today. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Order Delete messages after the End of Day.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Creations and/or Redemptions Suspended for Exchange Traded Product
Value.Description: Creations and/or Redemptions Suspended for Exchange Traded Product

Value.Name: Normal
Value.Description: Normal (Default): Issuer Is NOT Deficient, Delinquent, or Bankrupt

Value.Name: Not available
Value.Description: Not available. Firms should refer to SIAC feeds for code if needed.

Value.Name: Only round lots accepted
Value.Description: only round lots are accepted in this stock

Value.Name: Restricted
Value.Description: Issue is restricted under SEC Rule 203(b)(3)

Value.Name: New IPO security
Value.Description: NASDAQ listed instrument is set up as a new IPO security

Value.Name: Not a new IPO security
Value.Description: NASDAQ listed instrument is not set up as a new IPO security

Value.Name: Tier 1 NMS Stocks and select ETPs
Value.Description: Tier 1 NMS Stocks and select ETPs

Value.Name: ETP is not an Inverse ETP
Value.Description: ETP is not an Inverse ETP

Value.Name: Halted/Paused across all U.S. equity markets
Value.Description: Halted/Paused across all U.S. equity markets

Value.Name: Quotation only period for cross-market halt or pause
Value.Description: Quotation only period for cross-market halt or pause

Value.Name: Restriction in effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction in effect due to an intra-day price drop in security

Value.Name: Restriction remains in effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction remains in effect
